name: DaggerPad
notes: No build needed: the published app contains no game data and the player adds their own files in the app. Listed while the Public Repo Audit Tracker row allows its existing public release.

steps: Download the DaggerPad IPA from https://github.com/chrissotraidis/daggerpad/releases and check it against the SHA-256 file beside it.
Install it with AltStore Classic, SideStore or Sideloadly, signed with your own Apple ID.
Put a ZIP of your own Daggerfall game files, named daggerfall.zip, in Files. Open DaggerPad, tap Import and pick it, then tap Play when setup finishes.
